evidence.functional_evidence: cancel, decline and settle do not bind the maker/taker accounts to the bet, so an outsider or the opponent can take the stake. Happy-path make/take can work with the right accounts, but core fund movement is unsafe.

limitations: BUG: cancel never checks that the signing maker is bet.maker; the bet PDA is re-derived from the stored fields, so any wallet passes. The script's outsider X cancelled M's open bet and received M's 0.01 SOL stake plus the bet account rent (X +0.01141232 SOL, tx 5mnT3TqJ…).
BUG: decline doesn't tie the maker account to bet.maker either, so the opponent can decline and send the maker's refund and the rent to itself (O +0.01141232 SOL, tx 3xadSJkK…).

BUG: settle_bet takes maker and taker as plain accounts with no check against the bet, so the judge can pay the whole pot and the rent to any wallet, including its own (J +0.02141232 SOL, tx bdtntukm…), instead of only choosing between the two players.
There is no deadline: a matched bet stays locked until the judge settles it, and the judge has no stake.
The description is a PDA seed and is stored in 32 bytes, so it must be at most 32 bytes. The amount has no minimum, and the vault is drained with all its lamports.
The app's cluster defaults to devnet (clusterApiUrl('devnet'), the public endpoint, which can rate-limit). The cluster picker saves the choice in localStorage.
